column1: # scenes.tsv — the demo's six scenes (D-139, .ai/blueprints/demo-video.md §Component 2).
# Four TAB-separated columns: pane · prompt · until · timeout_s
#   pane     shell | architect | engineer — where the prompt is typed
#   prompt   the exact text typed (then Enter); "-" types nothing (the scene waits only)
#   until    one or more conditions joined by " ; ", met IN ORDER:
#              file:<path>        a file appears (relative to the project)
#              pane:<regex>       the scene's pane shows it (ERE, on the visible text)
#              architect:<regex>  the Architect pane shows it
#              engineer:<regex>   the Engineer pane shows it
#              comm:+<n>          .ai/COMM.md gains n "## Handoff" entries since the scene began
#              sleep:<s>          a fixed pause
#   timeout  seconds for the whole scene; the timeouts sum to the 25-minute wall-time cap
# Scene 1 ends on the input placeholder (Try "…"), which Claude Code shows only once a pane takes
# input: its banner text is already on screen behind the account, trust and MCP dialogs, and a
# prompt typed then is swallowed by the dialog.

architect
